changelog_text:
**KSP's jetpack, and the RCS stance. For KSA 2026.11.10.5801.**

- **Works on KSA 2026.11.10.5801 and later.** That build changed the game's XML format, and 0.6.0 doesn't load there: no Kerbal shows up. This version uses the new format, so it needs 5801 or later. (0.7.0 was never released.)

- **KSP's jetpack:** Kerbals now wear KSP's own jetpack instead of KSA's, which was too big for them and clipped through the body. Its control arms swing out when RCS is turned on and fold back when it is turned off.
- **RCS stance:** with RCS on, Kerbals stand, walk and jump with their hands on the controls, using KSP's jetpack animations. Turning RCS on or off while standing plays KSP's animation of reaching for the arms or putting them away.
- **RCS puffs:** the thruster puffs come from the KSP jetpack's own thrusters. Only the visuals move: the thrust is the game's own, so the jetpack flies exactly as before.
- The stance, the toggle animations, the arm timing and the puffs need the optional [Character Manager](https://github.com/paulo-santana/KSA-Character-Manager) 0.4.1 or later. Without it, Kerbals still wear KSP's jetpack, and its arms still move with RCS.
- **Bone names:** the Kerbals' arms, legs and spine now use the same bone names as the kittens, so mods that find those bones by name, like Fast & Purrious (the driver's hands on the wheel) and purr2d2, can find them on a Kerbal too.
- The clips and RCS puffs for Character Manager moved to their own file, `CharacterManager.xml`, which the game doesn't load. On 5801 the game rejects anything it doesn't know inside its own XML.
- The download shrinks from about 24 MB to about 14 MB, since KSA's jetpack is no longer copied in.

listing.name: KSP Characters
listing.abstract: Adds the Kerbals from Kerbal Space Program as crew characters, with KSP's own models, textures and animations.
listing.description:
Adds the Kerbals from Kerbal Space Program as crew characters in KSA, with KSP's own models, textures and animations: male and female, in KSP's white and orange suits. New crew are a random mix of kittens and Kerbals.

It is a data mod: no code and no mod loader. With the optional Character Manager, Kerbals get Kerbal names, and Jeb, Bill, Bob and Val join every new game.

What it includes and its known limitations are in the [README](https://github.com/paulo-santana/KSA-KSP-Characters#readme).

## Credits and legal

The Kerbals' models, textures, animations and name lists come from Kerbal Space Program and belong to its rights holders. This is a fan port, not affiliated with or endorsed by them or by Kitten Space Agency's developers. Only the XML definitions and the documentation are MIT licensed; see LICENSE.
